name: memoryatoms
description: MemoryAtoms: atomic memory cards for Claude Code.

plugins.name: memoryatoms
plugins.description: Atomic memory for Claude Code: injects the cards that fit your prompt, writes and searches cards through an MCP server, and harvests what a session learned.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-changelog-roll
plugins.description: Rolls old rows of _CHANGELOG.md into _CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in the background once it passes a row threshold; /changelog-debug runs it by hand.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-codex
plugins.description: Codex integration: /codex second opinion and build delegation, plus Codex Companion background review and acceptance judge.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-coordination
plugins.description: Multi-session coordination: warns when another live session edits the same file or is about to finish with git (warns only, never blocks).

plugins.name: memoryatoms-dashboard
plugins.description: Local web dashboard served from the MCP process: dashboard, brain-world, and the wrap-up report HUD.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-handoff
plugins.description: Automatic handoff notes: prepares next-phase-auto.md before compaction and at session end, warns when context is nearly full, and provides /handoff.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-statusline
plugins.description: Claude Code status line: edited files, knowledge queue, vector service, wrap-up report (zero tokens)

plugins.name: memoryatoms-usage-watch
plugins.description: Claude account usage monitor: scheduled quota checks, anomaly notifications, and a start-of-session hint when the monitor is not running.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-wisdom
plugins.description: Reflection stats: records how each session went and shows at most two self-awareness lines at session start.

plugins.name: memoryatoms-workflow-nudge
plugins.description: Working-style nudges: suggests fan-out for research-type requests and parallel sub-agents for independent work.
